name: PGLOBAL
recent: Pantech Global 于 10 月宣布以 RM31.73m 出售其位于 Klang 的前扩产用地，该地块原于 2024 年 12 月购入。公司同时宣派每股 2.2 仙的首次中期股息，并公布季度业绩，营收与净利均同比上升。近期董事在公开市场增持股份。
notable: 全资子公司 Pantech Steel Industries 与 Veltrix Land 签署买卖协议，以 RM31,731,000 出售一块永久地契土地。
宣派截至 2027 年 2 月 28 日财年的首次中期单层股息每股 2.2 仙。
公布截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日季度的业绩，营收与净利均同比上升。
risks: 董事 Tan Ang Ang 与 Jairus Tan Vern Hsien 在 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报增持股份。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日季度，营收为 RM173.707m，环比增长 8.8%，同比增长 38.3%；净利为 RM19.332m，环比增长 18.2%，同比增长 60.8%；净利率为 11.1%，高于上一季度的 10.2%。

recent_en: Pantech Global announced in October the disposal of its former Klang expansion land for RM31.73m, which was originally acquired in December 2024. The company also declared a first interim dividend of 2.2 sen per share and reported quarterly results with higher revenue and net profit year-on-year. Directors have recently acquired shares in the open market.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Pantech Steel Industries signed a sale and purchase agreement with Veltrix Land to dispose of a freehold land parcel for RM31,731,000.
Declared a first interim single-tier dividend of 2.2 sen per share for the financial year ending 28 February 2027.
Announced results for the quarter ended 31 August 2026, with revenue and net profit both higher year-on-year.
risks_en: Directors Tan Ang Ang and Jairus Tan Vern Hsien reported multiple acquisitions of shares between September and November.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM173.707m, up 8.8% QoQ and 38.3% YoY; net profit was RM19.332m, up 18.2% QoQ and 60.8% YoY; net margin was 11.1%, higher than 10.2% in the previous quarter.
